mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz ( teacher_id, material_id, title, difficulty, start_page, end_page, available_from, available_until ) VALUES ( #{teacherId}, #{materialId}, #{title}, #{difficulty}, #{startPage}, #{endPage}, #{availableFrom}, #{availableUntil} )

INSERT INTO quiz_question ( quiz_id, question_type, question_text, options, answer_text, explanation, question_order ) VALUES ( #{quizId}, #{questionType}, #{questionText}, CAST(#{options} AS jsonb), #{answerText}, #{explanation}, #{questionOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT q.quiz_id AS quizId, q.teacher_id AS teacherId, q.material_id AS materialId, q.title, q.difficulty, q.start_page AS startPage, q.end_page AS endPage, q.created_at AS createdAt, COUNT(qq.quiz_question_id) AS questionCount FROM quiz q LEFT JOIN quiz_question qq ON q.quiz_id = qq.quiz_id GROUP BY q.quiz_id ORDER BY q.created_at DESC

SELECT quiz_id AS quizId, teacher_id AS teacherId, material_id AS materialId, title, difficulty, start_page AS startPage, end_page AS endPage, available_from AS availableFrom, available_until AS availableUntil, created_at AS createdAt FROM quiz WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId}

SELECT quiz_question_id AS quizQuestionId, quiz_id AS quizId, question_type AS questionType, question_text AS questionText, options::text AS options, answer_text AS answerText, explanation, question_order AS questionOrder FROM quiz_question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY question_order ASC
mapper.update:
UPDATE quiz
title = #{request.title},
difficulty = #{request.difficulty},
start_page = #{request.startPage},
end_page = #{request.endPage},
WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId}

UPDATE quiz_question
question_type = #{request.questionType},
question_text = #{request.questionText},
options = CAST(#{request.options} AS jsonb),
answer_text = #{request.answerText},
explanation = #{request.explanation},
question_order = #{request.questionOrder},
WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND quiz_question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_attempt ( quiz_id, student_id, score, total_count, correct_count ) VALUES ( #{quizId}, #{studentId}, 0, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT quiz_attempt_id AS quizAttemptId, quiz_id AS quizId, student_id AS studentId, score, total_count AS totalCount, correct_count AS correctCount, started_at AS startedAt, submitted_at AS submittedAt FROM quiz_attempt WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND quiz_attempt_id = #{attemptId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_answer ( quiz_attempt_id, quiz_question_id, answer_text, is_correct ) VALUES ( #{quizAttemptId}, #{quizQuestionId}, #{answerText}, #{isCorrect} )
mapper.update: UPDATE quiz_attempt SET score = #{score}, total_count = #{totalCount}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, submitted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE quiz_attempt_id = #{attemptId}
mapper.select: SELECT qq.quiz_question_id AS quizQuestionId, qq.question_text AS questionText, qa.answer_text AS answerText, qq.answer_text AS correctAnswer, qa.is_correct AS isCorrect, qq.explanation AS explanation FROM quiz_answer qa JOIN quiz_question qq ON qa.quiz_question_id = qq.quiz_question_id WHERE qa.quiz_attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY qq.question_order ASC
